extension.summary: Flexible IPTV for Xtream Codes and M3U sources
Flexibele IPTV voor Xtream Codes en M3U-bronnen
extension.description: Reads your channel list from the Xtream API instead of a bulk get.php download, so it keeps working on providers where IPTV Simple fails. Writes a clean local M3U for IPTV Simple to read, so you keep Kodi's native EPG grid, and browses movies and series in the add-on itself. Includes diagnostics that report exactly what your provider accepts and refuses.

Haalt je kanaallijst uit de Xtream API in plaats van uit een grote get.php-download, en blijft daardoor werken bij providers waar IPTV Simple faalt. Schrijft een schone lokale M3U die IPTV Simple inleest, zodat je Kodi's eigen programmagids houdt, en bladert films en series in de add-on zelf. Bevat diagnostiek die precies laat zien wat je provider accepteert en weigert.
extension.news: 0.1.9 - Add an optional country filter to category browsing (?country=NL), so Movies/TV Shows can be added as a Kodi video library source that only ever lists categories starting with a given country code instead of every category the provider has. 0.1.8 - Replace the ffmpegdirect reconnect approach (0.1.6/0.1.7) with a local proxy: the provider's actual failure mode is a hard HTTP error on the very first request, not a dropped connection, and ffmpeg's reconnect_on_http_error option (the one that would cover that) turns out not to be forwarded by the installed inputstream.ffmpegdirect build at all - no Kodi property could ever have reached it. Movies and episodes now play through a small local HTTP server (in service.py) that makes the real, retried request before Kodi ever sees a response, including on seeks. 0.1.7 - Fix 0.1.6 not actually working: ffmpegdirect was correctly configured with reconnect options, but left at its default "open mode" it silently routes plain http(s) VOD I/O back through Kodi's own cURL (confirmed via its own debug log: "IO handled by Kodi's cURL"), the exact code path 0.1.6 was trying to get away from — so the reconnect options were simply never used. 0.1.6 - Fix intermittent VOD/live playback failures at the root cause instead of papering over them: Kodi's native player retries a failed connection only once, 35ms later, which cannot ride out the provider's brief backend hiccups. Movies and episodes (not just live TV) now play through inputstream.ffmpegdirect with ffmpeg's real HTTP reconnect enabled, the same class of resilience a player like TiviMate has natively. The pre-flight probe added in 0.1.3/0.1.5 is removed: it added a wait before playback without a reliability guarantee. 0.1.5 - Re-add the 0.1.3 playback probe, reverted in 0.1.4, after further testing showed the "competing connection" theory behind the revert did not hold up. 0.1.4 - Revert 0.1.3: the playback probe appeared to compete with Kodi's own connection. 0.1.3 - Probe the resolved URL before handing it to Kodi, to absorb transient provider 502s. 0.1.2 - Fix live TV playback failures ("Error creating demuxer"): the exported User-Agent was being silently truncated at its first space by IPTV Simple's own M3U parser, so the provider saw an incomplete header and refused the connection. The value is now quoted in the export. 0.1.1 - Fix VOD playback (ffmpegdirect was wrongly forced into live/timeshift mode for movies and episodes) and missing posters/thumbnails (artwork URLs now carry the provider's required User-Agent header). 0.1.0 - First release: Xtream API browsing, M3U export for IPTV Simple, VOD and series, provider diagnostics.
